description: One selectable value of a FacetGroup — the option row of a faceted filter. It carries the programmatic value the host filters on, the label a reader sees, an optional result count (what makes a facet a facet rather than a plain checkbox list), an optional decorative icon and IsDisabled for an option the current data cannot offer.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The programmatic value of the option, returned in its group's selection set. Values are matched ORDINALLY within a group; an empty value is ignored by the component.

properties.name: Label
properties.description: The human-readable label — the option's accessible name together with the count, when one is supplied. A blank label falls back to Value, so an option is never nameless.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: The number of results this option would leave, shown next to the label and included in the checkbox's accessible name. Null renders no count at all — a host that does not know the counts must not invent them.

properties.name: Icon
properties.description: Optional icon name resolved through the icon registry. Decorative: rendered aria-hidden, so the label stays the only carrier of meaning. An unknown name falls back to the generic icon.

properties.name: IsDisabled
properties.description: Disables this option: it renders disabled (keeping its count visible) and cannot be toggled. An option that is ALREADY selected stays selected and keeps its removable chip — the component never silently drops a filter the user applied earlier.

examples.title: An option with a count and an icon
examples.code: new FacetOption { Value = "books", Label = "Books", Count = 480, Icon = IconNames.Book }

examples.title: An option the current data cannot offer
examples.code: new FacetOption { Value = "toys", Label = "Toys", Count = 0, IsDisabled = true }
